1. (Currently amended) A computing device for mapping user movements captured by a capture device external to the computing device, to input events on the computing device, the computing device comprising: a display to display an application executing on the computing device; a client sharing module to: transmit video data of the application to a receiver device; and receive gesture data associated with the application, the gesture data based on movements of a user captured from a capture device communicatively coupled to the receiver device; and a mapping module to: map the gesture data into an input event on the computing device; and provide data simulating the input event to a sensor of the computing device, wherein the client sharing module is to establish a video channel between the computing device and receiver device.

2. (Currently amended) The computing device of claim 1, wherein to map the gesture data into an input event on the computing device, the mapping module is to: retrieve a type of movement of the user from the gesture data; and determine the input event based on the type of movement, wherein the mapping module further processes the gesture data to provide feedback to the user.

3. (Currently amended) The computing device of claim 2, wherein when the type of movement of the user is a swipe movement, the gesture data is mapped to a touch input event, and data simulating the touch input event is provided to a touch sensor of the computing device.

4. (Currently amended) The computing device of claim 2, wherein when the type of movement of the user is a lean movement, the gesture data is mapped to a rotate input event, and data simulating the rotate input event is provided to a gyroscope of the computing device.

5. (Currently amended) The computing device of claim 1, wherein the client sharing module is to: establish a video channel between the computing device and receiver device; establish an input channel between the computing device and receiver device; and wherein the video data is transmitted over the video channel and gesture data is received via the input channel, wherein the client sharing module is further configured to adaptively handle the input data based on the context of the application.

6. (Currently amended) The computing device of claim 1, wherein to transmit video data of the application to a receiver device, the client sharing module is to: wirelessly stream video displayed on the display of the computing device to the receiver device via the video channel.

7. (Currently amended) The computing device of claim 1, wherein the client sharing module is to transmit updated video data to the receiver device based on the application updating in response to the input event, wherein the updated video data reflects real-time application changes.

8. (Currently amended) A method of mapping user movements captured by a capture device external to a computing device, to input events on the computing device, the method comprising: executing an application on the computing device, using at least one processor of the computing device; transmitting, from the computing device, video data of the application to a receiver device; receiving, at the computing device from the receiver device, gesture data associated with the application, the gesture data based on movements of a user captured from a capture device communicatively coupled to the receiver device; mapping the gesture data to an input event on the computing device; and providing data simulating the input event to a sensor on the computing device, wherein the video data is transmitted over a video channel established between the computing device and the receiver device.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, wherein mapping the gesture data into an input event on the computing device comprises: retrieving a type of movement of the user from the gesture data; and determining the input event based on the type of movement, wherein mapping the gesture data into an input event further comprises adapting feedback based on the determined input event.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 11, wherein mapping the gesture data into an input event further comprises: mapping the gesture data to a touch input event when the type of movement is a swipe movement.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12, wherein providing the data simulating the input event to the sensor on the computing device comprises: providing data simulating the touch input event to a touch sensor on the computing device.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 11, wherein mapping the gesture data into an input event further comprises: mapping the gesture data to a rotate input event when the type of movement is a lean movement.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 14, wherein providing the data simulating the input event to the sensor on the computing device comprises: providing data simulating the rotate input event to a gyroscope sensor on the computing device.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, further comprising: establishing a video channel between the computing device and receiver device; establishing an input channel between the computing device and the receiver device; and wherein the video data is transmitted over the video channel and gesture data is received via the input channel, wherein the method further comprises adjusting the processing of the input data based on the current state of the application.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 16, wherein transmitting video data of the application to a receiver device comprises: wirelessly streaming video displayed on a display of the computing device to the receiver device via the video channel.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 19, further comprising: transmitting updated video data to the receiver device based on the application updating in response to the input event, wherein the updated video data includes the latest changes resulting from the input event.

17. (Currently amended) At least one machine-readable storage medium including instructions for mapping user movements captured by a capture device external to a computing device to input events on the computing device, which when executed by a machine, cause the machine to perform operations comprising: executing an application on the computing device; transmitting, from the computing device, video data of the application to a receiver device; receiving, at the computing device from the receiver device, gesture data associated with the application, the gesture data based on movements of a user captured from a capture device communicatively coupled to the receiver device; mapping the gesture data to an input event on the computing device; and providing data simulating the input event to a sensor on the computing device, wherein the mapping process considers the context of the application in real-time.

18. (Currently amended) The at least one machine-readable storage medium of claim 20, wherein mapping the gesture data into an input event on the computing device comprises: retrieving a type of movement of the user from the gesture data; and determining the input event based on the type of movement, wherein the instructions further enable feedback adjustments based on the input event defined by the type of movement.

19. (Currently amended) A capturing system to map user movements captured by a capture device to input events on a computing device, the system comprising: a receiver sharing module to receive video data of an application executing on a computing device external to the capturing system; an input capturing module to: receive user movement data of a user; and process the user movement data to determine a user gesture type and output gesture data; a mapping module to: receive the gesture data from the input capturing module; and map the gesture data into an input event on the computing device; generate mapped input data simulating the input event; and wherein the receiver sharing module is to transmit the mapped input data to the computing device, while adapting to changes in user input behavior.

20. (Currently amended) The capturing system of claim 22, wherein to map the gesture data into an input event on the computing device, the mapping module is to: retrieve a type of movement of the user from the gesture data; and determine the input event based on the type of movement, wherein the mapping module additionally incorporates user feedback loops in its process.

21. (Currently amended) The capturing system of claim 23, wherein when the type of movement of the user is a swipe movement, the gesture data is mapped to a touch input event and wherein the mapped input data includes data simulating the touch input event for a touch sensor of the computing device, while also tracking user performance for improvements.

22. (Currently amended) The capturing system of claim 23, wherein when the type of movement of the user is a lean movement, the gesture data is mapped to a rotate input event and wherein the mapped input includes data simulating the rotate input event provided for a gyroscope of the computing device, considering user preferences in the mapping process.
